newsitem.title: MEXICO: Grupo Maseca sets annual dividend.
newsitem.headline: Grupo Maseca sets annual dividend.

text.p: Grupo Industrial Maseca said Monday it will pay a cash dividend for the year of 0.215 peso for each of its 917.3 million shares in circulation.
Last year the company paid an annual dividend of 0.16 pesos per share, based on last year's peso.
Year-on-year inflation has been about 24.5 percent since the last dividend.
The corn flour producer said through the Mexican stock market that the payment will be made after May 7.
Maseca said shareholders approved an increase of up to 450 million pesos in the company's reserve fund to repurchase shares.
